text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Eishin Flash 
senses that there is a deeper meaning 
behind the Trainer's gaze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked, the Trainer honestly replied 
that they just wanted to cherish every 
last moment with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I love seeing you run." Remembering
those words, she looks back on where they 
started and how far they've come—and 
Eishin Flash, too,
comes to understand the 
bittersweet sorrow of parting.
